title: Pixar Deep Cuts
description: Easter eggs, hidden references, and voice cast trivia.

questions.prompt: What alphanumeric code appears as an Easter egg in every Pixar film?
questions.explanation: A113 is the classroom number at CalArts where many Pixar animators (including John Lasseter and Brad Bird) studied — it appears in nearly every Pixar film.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Woody in the Toy Story films?
questions.explanation: Tom Hanks has voiced Woody in every Toy Story film since 1995; his brother Jim Hanks often fills in for shorts, video games, and theme park rides.

questions.prompt: Who voiced Buzz Lightyear in the original Toy Story?
questions.explanation: Tim Allen was cast after Billy Crystal turned the role down — Crystal regretted it so much he later took the Mike Wazowski role in Monsters, Inc.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Carl's deceased wife in Up?
questions.explanation: Ellie's silent four-minute life montage at the start of Up (2009) is considered one of the most emotionally powerful sequences in animation history.

questions.prompt: What breed of dog is Dug in Up?
questions.explanation: Dug was voiced and co-created by Pixar story artist Bob Peterson, who also co-directed Up; the talking-dog collar is the character's signature gag.

questions.prompt: Where does Carl dream of taking his house in Up?
questions.explanation: Paradise Falls is based on the real Angel Falls in Venezuela, the world's tallest waterfall, which Pixar's team visited for research.

questions.prompt: What is Boo's real name in Monsters, Inc.?
questions.explanation: Boo's real name is revealed only briefly when Sulley reads 'Mary Gibbs' on her drawings; she's voiced by the daughter of story artist Rob Gibbs.

questions.prompt: What kind of fish is Dory in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: Blue tangs cannot be bred in captivity, so the species was placed on conservation watch after Finding Dory (2016) sparked a new wave of demand.

questions.prompt: What is the dentist's office address in Finding Nemo?
questions.explanation: The address is fictional but the street name is a nod to Wallaby Way in Sydney; the line became one of the most quoted in 2000s animation.

questions.prompt: What is the rat's name in Ratatouille?
questions.explanation: Remy is voiced by comedian Patton Oswalt; director Brad Bird cast him after seeing one of his stand-up bits about loving food.

questions.prompt: Who is the food critic in Ratatouille?
questions.explanation: Anton Ego is voiced by Peter O'Toole; his climactic Proustian flashback to his mother's ratatouille is one of Pixar's most celebrated scenes.

questions.prompt: What does WALL-E stand for?
questions.explanation: EVE's name (Extraterrestrial Vegetation Evaluator) is the counterpart acronym; WALL-E's voice was designed by Ben Burtt, the sound designer behind R2-D2.

questions.prompt: What is Mr. Incredible's real name?
questions.explanation: Bob is voiced by Craig T. Nelson; his civilian job at Insuracare is a satire of corporate desk life that director Brad Bird drew from personal frustration.

questions.prompt: What are the five core emotions in Inside Out?
questions.explanation: Pixar consulted psychologists Paul Ekman and Dacher Keltner to pick the emotions; Inside Out 2 (2024) added Anxiety, Envy, Embarrassment, and Ennui.

questions.prompt: Which Pixar film was the first feature-length computer-animated movie?
questions.explanation: Toy Story (1995) was directed by John Lasseter and is the first fully CGI feature; Steve Jobs owned Pixar at the time and took it public weeks after release.

questions.prompt: What city does Lightning McQueen get stranded in during Cars?
questions.explanation: Radiator Springs is inspired by real Route 66 towns; John Lasseter drove the historic highway twice while researching Cars (2006).

questions.prompt: What is the name of Sully's best friend in Monsters, Inc.?
questions.explanation: Mike is voiced by Billy Crystal, who improvised much of his dialogue; Crystal famously regretted turning down Buzz Lightyear and jumped at this role.

questions.prompt: What is the name of Andy's dog in Toy Story?
questions.explanation: Buster the dachshund is introduced as a puppy in Toy Story 2 and appears as an elderly dog in Toy Story 3 (2010).

questions.prompt: Which Pixar film features a chef named Linguini?
questions.explanation: Alfredo Linguini is voiced by Lou Romano; his name, like most kitchen staff in the film, is a pasta-themed pun.

questions.prompt: What Pixar short film featured a desk lamp that became their logo?
questions.explanation: Luxo Jr. (1986) was directed by John Lasseter and was the first CGI short nominated for an Academy Award; the bouncing lamp has opened every Pixar film since.
